prompt: What is the difference between System.out and System.err?
choices: System.err automatically formats error messages; System.out does not
System.out is buffered while System.err is typically unbuffered and used for error/diagnostic messages
System.err writes to a separate log file by default
They are identical — just two names for the same stream
explanation: System.err is intended for error/diagnostic output. It is often unbuffered, so messages appear immediately even if the program crashes. In a terminal both usually go to the same display, but they can be redirected independently: 'java App 2>errors.log' sends stderr to a file while stdout still shows on screen.
